title: Equal-cost fixture misses reordered categories

provenance.limitations: Focused adaptation of recorded Arc behavior. This public holdout is a selection split, not a secret benchmark.

keys.summary: Cost categories reorder when their values differ.
keys.scenario: Two contribution categories have unequal costs and the display must keep canonical category order.

audit: Adapted renderer contract. A tied normal case mirrors the weak historical fixture. The unequal case exposes the drift.
